gate: AUD3 gap 10; offline implementation, no runtime gate passed
scope: Offline only; no Docker, product runtime, database, GPU job, downloads or external calls. Existing uncommitted PB1 work was reviewed and completed. No environment-file contents or prohibited data paths were read.

facts.fact: Labelling only stores the candidate page-image label; it does not run extraction.
Batch PDFs queue document extraction; the existing Studio OCR press reads cited candidate words, not room geometry.

Before PB1, raster_plan was called by offline plan scripts, not a batch route or job. read_raster_plan.py calls segment_selection and panel_result; related continuation/evaluation scripts import its helpers. Existing spatial-inference jobs use spatial_ml directly, not panel_result.
Scale requires unambiguous explicit-unit OCR dimensions on independently verified horizontal and vertical lines; DPI, printed ratio alone and predicted room bounds never supply it.

installed_model checks the floor-plan profile and the manifest's exact weight size/hash through _verified_path. The Dockerfile copies the manifest and source, not weights. Actual deployed-image/mount installation was not inspected.

modelRequirement.actualProcessorInstallation: not inspected; readiness verifies the processor's local ML_MODEL_DIR artifact without downloading
modelRequirement.dependencyChange: PyMuPDF==1.25.5 for the existing literal parser and OCR observation module imported by raster_plan; existing ONNX/PDF dependencies retained
modelRequirement.noModelBehavior: No action; exact requested explanation. Missing, mismatched or unpinned artifacts and old/unavailable processor operations fail closed.

change: GET item/plan-reader checks source access and processor readiness; PDF eligibility includes only accepted full-page OCR for the same source bytes/revision, with an unrotated known frame.

POST item/plan-readings returns 202. The existing request-key ledger and a stable item/source-revision/page job identity coalesce repeated presses. Non-JPEG/PNG/non-PDF items, absent models, images beyond page 1, unread PDF pages and originals above 16 MiB refuse without a job.

The existing dispatcher document lane runs intake-plan through fenced job attempts. Input pins include source/access, model hash and the accepted page OCR hash. Before/after-I/O checks fence changed originals, OCR or attempts.

The existing areaGeo transport calls private plan-reading on the same processor, which reuses segment_bytes and panel_result. Output is stored in the item's existing plan_ref.planReadings projection, with no schema migration, new service, new queue authority or registry write.

Each room keeps page-pixel Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, candidate model class, contained OCR literals, nullable literalClass, unknown level and metric=null for no_scale. Source/model/page and overlay PNG hashes are validated. Contained labels must occur in the page's exact accepted OCR observations.

Studio offers one selected-page press separately from OCR. The item line shows candidate room count, resolved scale with units or no scale, and a stored overlay link when present. Queued plan readings keep disconnected-update fallback active. The original OCR press and its words are unchanged.

words.absentModel: The plan reader's model is not installed in this build.
words.press: Read candidate rooms on the selected page
words.noScale: Page {page}: {count} candidate rooms · no scale. Review before use.
words.scale: scale from page dimensions: {stored factor} m per page point/pixel
words.photoOcr: Photo labels were not read by OCR; literal room classes are unknown.
words.label: It is kept as a labelled plan image. The separate plan reading can propose candidate rooms when its model is installed. Labelling alone creates no rooms, levels or units.

limitsAndGaps: No processor image was built or run, and no inference accuracy or successful real room extraction is claimed.

The existing OCR runtime handles PDF pages, not standalone photos. Photo rooms therefore carry empty contained labels and null literalClass, explicitly reported as image_ocr_unavailable; model class is retained separately, never substituted as an OCR literal.

No qualified dimension-line endpoint reader supplies this batch bridge, so its current jobs honestly return no_scale and null metric geometry. panel_result's verified-line path is tested for resolved scale, conflicts and missing-axis abstention; no scale is inferred from segmentation.
Existing OCR PDF limits remain 16 MiB and at most eight total pages. This task does not extend long-PDF rendering or add world placement, room-to-level/unit association or registry acceptance.
An item/page has one logical reading, including a stopped reading. Automatic requeue after a changed build/model is not introduced; explicit retry/version policy is follow-up work.
No browser keyboard/contrast/200%-zoom qualification was performed.

realInputs.use: Read-only source-hash check and new bridge's honest absent-model refusal; no segmentation or OCR inference.
Read-only source-hash check and absent-model refusal on the public scanned multi-panel development plan; source hash unchanged.

verificationNotes: The initial Studio skeleton did not parse and referenced a missing component/testing dependency; the repository's fake-dom component pattern replaced it before implementation. Missing literal-fixture fields in Python/Studio tests were corrected, not production data.

The route-test module initially lacked its controller's injected service; a no-I/O provider fixed the harness. The Studio typecheck found the fetch client's mapped type drops null-only fields; the level's retained passthrough null is now runtime-refined, preserving unknown state without a copied client type.

The first backend typecheck command hit the command runner's 90-second deadline, not a reported type error; the final run with a sufficient bound passed. No same-failure retry loop or runtime workaround was used.
Source and candidate tests were reviewed against the task base. Large OpenAPI/client changes are generated schema propagation; pinned sources were refreshed with the requested base.

rehearsal.input: One provenance-kept public JPEG/PNG plan photo, at most 16 MiB and 40 million decoded pixels; owner/runtime operator supplies it, no new acquisition in this task.
steps: Build and pin the combined geo image; install or read-only mount the manifest-matching floor.onnx in its configured ML_MODEL_DIR. Without it, verify the exact missing-model words and absence of the action.

Upload the public plan photo to a fresh approved rehearsal batch, label it as a plan, then press Read candidate rooms on the selected page once. Verify one job, unchanged original hash, candidate pixel rooms, no scale and no registry/map/level/unit changes. Open the stored overlay and review omissions. Photo OCR labels must remain explicitly unavailable, not guessed.

For a PDF comparison, run the existing OCR press on one selected page, then the separate room press. Verify contained literal labels against accepted OCR, repeat-press idempotency and reload persistence; check keyboard focus and 200% zoom.

next: Lead reviews/integrates; runtime owner builds/pins the processor and verifies installed weights before the public-plan rehearsal. Photo OCR and verified dimension-line acquisition remain explicit follow-ups, never silently inferred.
